subject: PO telemetry & spend cap — BlueHen onboarding itemization correction
messages:
From: Jules Mercier <jules@bluehen.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: procureops@bluehen.com
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: PO number and spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday — BlueHen is excited to move into the sandbox stage. Our finance team is asking for two things so we can kick off early procurement and tag invoices correctly:

1) A provisional PO number (we're doing vendor billing in parallel to the SOW).
2) The spend cap you plan to apply for the initial trial (we anticipated ~$18k over the first 30 days but need Redwood to confirm).

One small data hiccup we spotted: the sample invoice export (attached) has line items that map to two internal SKU codes but our ledger expects three discrete SKUs for cost center mapping. Can you confirm if Redwood will issue corrected line items or if we should remap on our side?

Attachments: BH-PO-8421.csv (csv) — sample invoice export; bluehen-onboarding-form.pdf (pdf) — vendor onboarding intake

Quick ask: can you get back to us with a provisional PO and spend cap by EOD today? The procurement team wants to queue the first payment run on Mon.

Best,
Jules
Head of Procurement, BlueHen Analytics
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Jules Mercier <jules@bluehen.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number and spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Thanks Jules — appreciate the clear ask and the sample export. Looping in Priyom and Laura from procurement to own PO issuance and spend cap.

Short answers up front:
- We can provide a provisional PO number for sandbox billing.
- We'll confirm the initial spend cap (targeted to match your $18k estimate or note a slight difference depending on token telemetry).

Priyom / Laura — can you confirm a provisional ponum and whether Redwood should push corrected line items back to BlueHen or provide a mapping file for their ledger? If we provide corrected CSVs, please include a note about SKU normalization rules so their AP can auto-ingest.

Jules — I put a hold on Monday's payment until we align on the PO and line mapping. If needed we can also provide a short mapping sheet and a temporary ledger id for your QA.

— Jordan

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: PO number and spend cap confirmation for onboarding

Hi Jules — thanks for the CSV and onboarding form; I reviewed the sample and here's a concise plan so BlueHen can proceed without blocking Monday's run.

Action items and timeline:
1) Provisional PO: RED-PO-2026-8421-TEMP (provisionally assigned). Use this for sandbox billing; we'll replace with a final PO once the contract is executed.
2) Spend cap: Initial provisional cap set to $18,500 for the first 30 days to accommodate token variability. We'll re-evaluate after telemetry week 1.
3) Line-item correction: The sample invoice collapses two vendor-level SKUs into a single consolidated line. Procurement will produce a corrected ledger CSV with three normalized SKUs and a map file for BlueHen to ingest. Target: deliver corrected CSV + mapping by Fri EOD (2026-10-02).
4) Temporary ledger id: redwood-ledger-527 (for BlueHen's AP to tag incoming invoices); this maps to RED-PO-2026-8421-TEMP.

Attachments: redwood-ponum-assignment.xlsx (xlsx) — provisional PO and mapping reference.

Notes on normalization rules (summary):
- If a single invoice line contains multiple usage categories, we will split by usage tag (compute, tokens-embedding, support) into discrete SKU rows.
- Each normalized SKU will include a partner_sku_code field (present in mapping file) so your system can join and tag cost centers.

Jules — please confirm you can accept RED-PO-2026-8421-TEMP for the payment run and that the $18,500 provisional cap is acceptable. We'll follow up with the corrected CSV.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

- Spend cap: locked at $18,500 for first 30 days; auto-alert triggers at 70% and 90% usage.

Attachments referenced: corrected_invoice_BH-8421_v2.csv (csv) — corrected line-splits; BH_sku_map_v1.csv (csv) — mapping file; audit_note_BH-8421.txt (txt) — short explanation of the split logic.
